title: Prediction research protocol: does a model know anything the betting market does not?
frozen_on_instruction_of: owner, 2026-10-12: "Proceed with Step 2: establish the Independent Auditor and preregister CFL's prediction research protocol."

anchor.base_commit_note: main at freeze time: the stabilization session's schedule removal for the social poster. The stabilization pull requests #54-#57 are not merged at freeze and are not required by this protocol.

dev.rule: the only fights development code may read, fit, tune, select features on or look at results for

h1.rule: sealed historical holdout. Scored only by the auditor, only through the ledger, only once per registered model artifact. Ends on the last card that carries a BestFightOdds closing consensus, so one benchmark covers the whole window.

reserve.rule: sealed and unscored. No consistent closing benchmark exists for it (BestFightOdds history stops 2026-07-11; clean per-book capture starts 2026-09-19). Not available to development. Using it for anything needs an amendment.

prospective.rule: fights whose forecast is locked, append-only, after the model artifact is frozen and before the fight's start. The only data on which an outcome cannot have been seen by anyone.

thresholds.primary_metric: log loss, natural log, probabilities clipped to [1e-4, 1-1e-4]
thresholds.minimum_useful_effect_note: per-fight mean log-loss gain over the market. Same value DUR-001/DUR-002 preregistered. A smaller gain is treated as no meaningful incremental information whatever its p-value.
thresholds.sd_floor_source: measured on the dev partition only (2023-01-01..2024-12-31, 643 fights, 85 events, BFO closing consensus): SD of per-fight LL_model - LL_market was 0.311-0.317 for the standalone v1-v3 models and 0.062-0.063 for a fixed 80/20 logit blend of market and model. Rounded up.
thresholds.design_effect_measured: 0.72-0.85 on the same dev rows; floored at 1.0 because a measured value below 1 is not a licence to need fewer fights

claim_ladder.PASS_H1: may say internally: 'showed a historical signal on sealed data; prospective test registered'. Nothing public.
claim_ladder.PASS_PROSPECTIVE: may say: 'added information beyond the market on N fights forecast in advance'. Public use is still L3 (CRITICAL_GATES item 8).
claim_ladder.betting_advantage: requires PASS_PROSPECTIVE AND the frozen CLV-001 publication gate open AND a positive CLV_return lower bound on the same model's locked forecasts. Simulated ROI alone never supports it.
